📖 How to use

  1. Choose 5 or 10 seconds and press “Start”.
  2. Wait for the 3-2-1 countdown — don't click early.
  3. Click the arena as fast as you can until time's up.
  4. See your clicks, CPS and best score.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is CPS calculated?

Clicks per second = total clicks ÷ seconds. The test counts only clicks inside the arena while the timer runs.

Is my best saved?

Your best CPS for each duration (5s and 10s) is saved in your browser.

What's a good score?

Most people tap 5–8 clicks per second with one finger; 10+ usually needs two fingers or a fast mouse.
